name: Supply Chain Security
purpose: Verify package checksums, signatures, lockfile integrity, and malicious dependency detection.
inputs: Dependency manifests, lockfiles, and package-manager policy
CI build, install flags, and release provenance configuration
Current vulnerability, license, and incident advisories
outputs: Dependency and provenance findings with package evidence
Pinned lockfile, SBOM, and safe-install remediation
CVE, license, signature, and freeze-gate evidence
stop_conditions: Lockfile, provenance, SBOM, vulnerability, and license gates pass with an incident owner
